A revalidation at 22:46:30 (after peer XCUT siblings + Z2-NF525 completed) captured 2 NEW orders (#226 + #227) + 11 new audit_logs total + 2 additional z_reports (#3 + #4). This file reflects the REVALIDATED state. Per advisor freshness rule: a third revalidation may be required if downstream agents (Z3-WIZARD wizard order creation, Z4-LATENCY post-write measurements) continue past 22:46:30.

verdict: ALL_INTEGRITY_GREEN — 2 REAL Wave C orders ledgered (#226 parent fixture + #227 refund mirror, both via Z2-NF525 service-path test). All numeric fields cross-reconcile across orders.total, order_payments.amount, z_reports.total_ttc, and audit_logs.payload.total_ttc / .amount / .mirror_total. NF525 chain (audit_logs HMAC + z_reports double-link) extends cleanly across the +18 audit entries and +4 z_reports. Fiscal sequence monotonic gap-free (37 → 39). composition_snapshot is NULL on both order_items (#161 + #162) — flagged as TEST_HELPER service-path artifact, NOT integrity drift (production kiosk/POS-wizard path DOES populate composition_snapshot per real-live-flow-2026-05-28 baseline).
verdict_schema_extension: Mission spec defined verdict as 'ALL_INTEGRITY_GREEN | DETECTED_DRIFT'. Initial snapshot at 22:42:30 had hit a third state NO_REAL_ORDERS_CREATED_DURING_WAVE_C — that state was REVALIDATED AWAY by the 22:46:30 re-snapshot which captured 2 new orders + 11 new audit entries from peer agents that completed after the initial snapshot. Final verdict aligns with the spec's primary GREEN value.

advisory_findings.finding: Wave C new orders #226 + #227 were created via service-path direct insertion (Z2-NF525 refund S1 fixture + RefundWithCounterEntryService) and bypass the standard PricingService + FrontendOrderService creation flow. As a result, order_items.composition_snapshot is NULL on both. This is by design for the refund integration test (Z2-NF525/refund.json explicitly documents the S1 scenario as a sealed-order refund path test).
advisory_findings.recommendation: Acceptable. composition_snapshot NULL on test-helper orders is consistent with Wave B doctrine. For future Wave D 'live-orders' supervisor that drives kiosk wizard happy-path, composition_snapshot WILL be populated and that wave's ledger should assert composition_snapshot_present=true on every new order.

advisory_findings.finding: Z2-NF525 closed 4 z_reports in sequence: Z #1 (empty), Z #2 (empty), Z #3 (empty), Z #4 (captures order #226 — 11 TTC). The first 3 empty Z closes are validation cycles for the NF525 chain-extension path; only Z #4 captured real fiscal data.

audit_logs.payload field names vary by action: z_report.closed uses 'total_ttc' + 'order_count' + 'signature' + 'prev_hash'; cash.movement.recorded uses 'amount' + 'direction' + 'movement_id'; order.refund.counter_entry uses 'mirror_total' + 'parent_fiscal_sequence_no'. Mission spec asked for unified 'audit_log.payload.total' — that field name does NOT exist canonically.
advisory_findings.recommendation: Future XCUT ledger schemas should map per-action: order.created.payload.total | z_report.closed.payload.total_ttc | cash.movement.recorded.payload.amount | order.refund.counter_entry.payload.mirror_total. No code change needed; document the field map.

advisory_findings.finding: Initial snapshot at 22:42:30 missed orders #226 + #227 (created at 22:44:11 and 22:46:09 respectively). Without the 22:46:30 revalidation triggered by advisor freshness rule, this ledger would have falsely reported NO_REAL_ORDERS_CREATED_DURING_WAVE_C.
advisory_findings.recommendation: Future XCUT supervisors should snapshot AFTER all peer Z dirs contain at least one artifact file, OR snapshot twice with ≥4-min gap. Codify in supervisor playbook.

evidence_citations.schema_orders: DESCRIBE orders — total decimal(19,6), fiscal_sequence_no bigint nullable, transaction_id varchar(191) nullable, source varchar(191) nullable, queue_number varchar(20), composition_snapshot lives on order_items, not orders. parent_order_id UNIQUE — refund mirrors enforce 1:1.
evidence_citations.schema_order_items: DESCRIBE order_items — composition_snapshot json nullable. Verified 12/12 NULL on order_id 215-227 (Wave B synthetic + Wave C TEST_HELPER).
evidence_citations.schema_audit_logs: DESCRIBE audit_logs — payload json nullable, prev_hash char(64), current_hash char(64). HMAC-chained per FiscalSequenceService / AuditLogService (frozen §7).
evidence_citations.schema_z_reports: DESCRIBE z_reports — total_ttc decimal(15,2), total_ht decimal(15,2), total_tva decimal(15,2), prev_hash char(64), signature char(64), sequence_no bigint. Double-chained: z_reports.prev_hash mirrors the previous z_reports.signature; audit_logs.payload (for action=z_report.closed) ALSO carries prev_hash + signature for cross-validation.
evidence_citations.schema_order_payments: DESCRIBE order_payments — amount decimal(10,2), tendered decimal(10,2), change_amount decimal(10,2), mode tinyint. mode=1=cash.
